fields.description: Nouran Living is Aldar’s mid-rise residential development in Saadiyat Island’s Marina District. Its 372-home launch collection spans studios and one-to-three-bedroom apartments, with a courtyard, social lounges and facilities for everyday work, exercise and leisure.

overview: Nouran Living is organised around a shared courtyard and indoor social spaces. Its design offers two interior colour choices and includes practical communal areas for reading, co-working and exercise. The typical three-bedroom layout includes a study and maid’s room; selected two-bedroom types also provide a maid’s room.
research.locationNote: Aldar places Nouran Living in Saadiyat’s Marina District, close to NYU Abu Dhabi and the planned marina waterfront. The E12 provides wider island connections. Marina facilities described at launch should not be assumed operational without checking.
research.priceNote: Aldar announced prices from AED 750,000 when sales opened in March 2024. Property Finder now distinguishes resale listings from developer stock; the launch figure is historical and does not confirm current availability.
research.paymentNote: The reported schedule totals 65% before completion and 35% on handover. Confirm the instalment dates and any paid balance for the selected residence.
research.handoverNote: The official March 2024 launch expected Q4 2027 handovers; the current project portal reports the same quarter. The signed agreement governs the particular unit.
